title: Detailed mobile phone
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- phone body -->
  <rect x="28" y="8" width="44" height="84" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#3a4a7a"/>
  <!-- outer edge highlight -->
  <rect x="29.5" y="9.5" width="41" height="81" rx="6.5" ry="6.5" fill="none" stroke="#7a9bd4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- screen bezel -->
  <rect x="32" y="14" width="36" height="66" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#1e2a4a"/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x="34" y="16" width="32" height="50" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#5bc8f5"/>
  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="34" y="16" width="32" height="6" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#2a6a99"/>
  <!-- signal bars -->
  <rect x="36" y="19" width="2" height="1.5" fill="#a8e8ff"/>
  <rect x="39" y="17.5" width="2" height="3" fill="#a8e8ff"/>
  <rect x="42" y="16.5" width="2" height="4" fill="#a8e8ff"/>
  <!-- battery icon -->
  <rect x="58" y="17" width="5" height="3.5" rx="0.5" fill="#a8e8ff"/>
  <rect x="63" y="18" width="1" height="1.5" rx="0.3" fill="#a8e8ff"/>
  <!-- app icons row 1 -->
  <rect x="37" y="25" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <rect x="46" y="25" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <rect x="55" y="25" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#7af5a0"/>
  <!-- app icons row 2 -->
  <rect x="37" y="34" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#c77dff"/>
  <rect x="46" y="34" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#ff9f6b"/>
  <rect x="55" y="34" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#6bc5ff"/>
  <!-- app icons row 3 -->
  <rect x="37" y="43" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <rect x="46" y="43" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#ff8fab"/>
  <rect x="55" y="43" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#95f070"/>
  <!-- dock -->
  <rect x="35" y="53" width="30" height="10" rx="4" fill="#2a8ab5"/>
  <rect x="37" y="55" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#a8e8ff"/>
  <rect x="46" y="55" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <rect x="55" y="55" width="6" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <!-- home button -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="4.5" fill="#4a5a9a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="3" fill="#7a9bd4"/>
  <!-- camera -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="84.5" r="2.5" fill="#2a3a6a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="84.5" r="1.5" fill="#5bc8f5"/>
  <!-- earpiece -->
  <rect x="44" y="10.5" width="12" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5a6a9a"/>
  <!-- volume buttons -->
  <rect x="26.5" y="30" width="1.5" height="6" rx="0.75" fill="#7a9bd4"/>
  <rect x="26.5" y="39" width="1.5" height="6" rx="0.75" fill="#7a9bd4"/>
  <!-- power button -->
  <rect x="72" y="33" width="1.5" height="8" rx="0.75" fill="#7a9bd4"/>
</svg>
